No rides on Sundays or holidays.

plans.name: Gio Health Services Inc
plans.address: 6323 Georgia Avenue NW, Suite 360, Washington, DC 20011
steps: Book the appointment with Gio Health Services and ask for a Dari interpreter.
The trip is about 0.7 mi and she walks. Plan the walk, and keep the ride as a backup if she cannot walk it.
For a ride, call AmeriHealth Caritas DC at 1-800-315-3485 at least 48 hours ahead (not counting weekends and holidays). No rides on Sundays or holidays.
If she wants a loaded SmarTrip card instead, ask for it 3-5 business days ahead.
Ask about childcare and whether her child can come to the visit.
Bring her photo ID, insurance card and phone number.
plans.tell_client: The clinic is close, about 0.7 miles, and you can walk. If walking is hard, we can call to book a ride at least 2 days before.

questions.text: She uses the bus with help. Who can ride with her, or can the ride service help her board?
Can her young child ride along, and is there a car seat or childcare at the visit?
Once the appointment is set, book the ride with AmeriHealth Caritas DC rides (Medicaid managed care) early enough (see booking notes).

extra_questions: Is she able to walk 0.7 mi while pregnant?
Does the clinic allow children in the visit?

plans.name: Washington Hospital Center — Outpatient Behavioral Health Services
plans.address: 216 Michigan Avenue NE, 2nd Floor, Washington, DC 20017
plans.grade_basis: 2.3 mi; she uses Metro or Metrobus.
steps: Book the appointment with Washington Hospital Center Outpatient Behavioral Health and ask for a Dari interpreter.
The trip is about 2.3 mi by Metrobus. Any travel time is only an estimate, so check the route with her before the visit.
For a ride, call AmeriHealth Caritas DC at 1-800-315-3485 at least 48 hours ahead (not counting weekends and holidays). No rides on Sundays or holidays.
For a loaded SmarTrip card, ask 3-5 business days ahead.

For 50% off Metrobus, enroll in Metro Lift online at wmata.com/metrolift or in person at L'Enfant, Silver Spring or Rosslyn. Bring a SmarTrip card for each person, her active SNAP EBT card, the SNAP benefits summary, photo ID and phone number.
Ask about childcare and whether her child can come to the visit.
plans.tell_client: This clinic is about 2 miles away. You can take the bus, or we can try to book a ride at least 2 days before.

questions.text: She uses the bus with help. Who can ride with her, or can the ride service help her board?
Can her young child ride along, and is there a car seat or childcare at the visit?
Once the appointment is set, book the ride with AmeriHealth Caritas DC rides (Medicaid managed care) early enough (see booking notes).

extra_questions: Does she have an active SNAP EBT card for the Metro Lift discount?
Can she ride the bus with her child, or does she need help?
